text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Satono Diamond has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've been quite busy lately, haven't
you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, the opposite actually. I wanted to
ask you to
take a break. You've been
overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stubborn! You don't look
fine at all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's right! The hot spring
vacation!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Remember the coupon we won for a hot
spring
vacation? We should go!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We promised to show appreciation for
each
other, so let's go! What do you
say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond calls the inn and makes
a
reservation then and there. Before I
realize it,
we're standing in front of our
lodgings.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How lucky that there was a room
available for us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this isn't your average day! Take
your mind
off work for a little while!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm anxious about my work, but since
Satono
Diamond went out of her way to
take me here, I
decide to enjoy myself
to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry into the hot spring and wash
away our
stress! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Aaah! The water felt great.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: See? I knew you were tired.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would you like a shoulder massage?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of what I can do to thank
you for
everything you've done for me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This must be because we promised to be
more
thankful toward each other. I'm
touched by her
sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to the inn's information
pamphlet,
there's a stream in the
mountains behind our
lodging.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! That sounds nice and
refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We find the stream after descending
some steps
near the inn. The susurration
of the flowing water
is soothing and
pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The water is so nice and cool.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there are any fish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond looks deeply curious as
she
leans over to peer into the river,
before dipping
her hand in.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! There's a suspension bridge
over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's go take a look!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow... This looks pretty scary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond places one foot on the
rickety
suspension bridge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't go far. I'll just take a few steps
and come
back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, she nimbly skips
on to the
bridge and stops halfway
across.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The view is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I got a beautiful shot! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Take a look, Trainer. The view from the
bridge is
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I just feel so at ease with you
watching
over me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I once crossed a suspension bridge with
Kita when
we were young.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita went on the bridge first, and I
followed after.
Seeing her walking in
front of me made me feel
safe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I feel the same now as I did
then. When
you're with me, I feel so safe
that I don't pay
attention to my
surroundings properly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That goes for earlier on the bridge, and
during
races too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's no excuse for my
irresponsible
behavior. I'll be careful
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You can't make history without jumping
head first
into a little trouble. If she ever
really overexerts
herself, then I'll step in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I want is for her to follow her heart,
and keep
her eyes on the prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, that is what makes her Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you to watch over me
from here
on out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't take your eyes off me, even for a
second! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Satono Diamond and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
